meta.title: EvoOntology semantic layer
meta.description: A versioned, evidence-grounded semantic layer (ontology) for the current agent, inspired by ruc-datalab/EvoOntology and implemented as a native DSH plugin. Registers 8 evo_* tools (status / browse / resolve / history / commit / publish / revert / export), an /evo command, and three skills (build, use, evolve). Semantics live in one SQLite file at $DSH_HOME/evoontology/store.db, opened in-process: no Python, no child process, no network. Terms, field mappings and constraints must cite a re-runnable observation, and versions are immutable, diffable and free to roll back. Data stays local: only evidence digests and re-runnable probes are stored, never sample rows. Disabling the bundle removes the tools, command and skills; store.db and runs/ are kept — delete $DSH_HOME/evoontology to clean up completely.
